jobs.description: 🚀 Filiz est une start-up innovante de la EdTech, en pleine croissance et dans un contexte international à venir, qui simplifie et automatise les démarches administratives et financières liées aux contrats d’alternance et de stage. Hexa Scale accompagne des entreprises SaaS B2B ambitieuses ayant de la traction, pour les aider à passer à l’échelle supérieure grâce à des investissements et un accompagnement opérationnel sur mesure. 💥 Filiz a déjà doublé son ARR deux années de suite, en s’appuyant presque exclusivement sur l’inbound et le bouche-à-oreille. La machine Marketing tourne. L'équipe Sales se structure. C'est le bon moment pour rejoindre et performer. 🎯 Ta mission Tu rejoins une équipe Sales naissante de 2 personnes : Elsa, notre Head of Sales et Eva, Sales full cycle, dans un contexte où les bases sont posées et les leads arrivent. Ton rôle : faire tourner un cycle de vente complet sur du SMB, avec vélocité et précision dans un marché qui répond. Pas question de tout construire de zéro. Il s'agit d'exécuter, itérer et performer sur de l'inbound bien qualifié et de l'outbound que tu pilotes pour compléter ton pipe. 💯 Responsabilités 1. Gérer ton pipe de A à Z - Traiter les leads entrants générés par le marketing avec réactivité et méthode - Construire et alimenter ta partie outbound (environ 2/3 de ton pipe) : identification, qualification, approche des écoles cibles - Piloter tes opportunités avec rigueur, du premier contact à la signature 2. Closer avec empathie et efficacité - Mener les discovery et démos, gérer les objections, conclure sur des cycles courts, avec cadence - Maintenir une haute vélocité sans sacrifier la qualité de la relation - Travailler en proximité avec la Head of Sales pour affiner les approches et partager les bonnes pratiques 3. Développer le revenu au-delà du closing - Identifier et activer les opportunités d'upsell au sein de ton portefeuille client (nouveaux modules, montée en gamme) - Collaborer avec le marketing et le Customer Success pour maximiser l'expansion revenue 4. Contribuer à la structuration commerciale - Documenter les pitchs gagnants, les objections récurrentes, les séquences qui fonctionnent - Participer à l'enrichissement du Sales Playbook dans une équipe qui se structure sans repartir de zéro 🤩 Profil recherché - 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en ventes B2B SaaS, sur des cycles complets (prospection → closing) - Tu es à l'aise sur du SMB : tu sais gérer le volume, maintenir la cadence et closer sans t'éterniser - Tu es autonome et organisé·e, capable de jongler entre inbound et outbound sans perdre le fil - Tu closes avec méthode et empathie, sans bullshit, sans pression inutile - Tu maîtrises les outils modernes (CRM, automatisation, stack outbound) - Tu aimes évoluer dans un environnement en structuration, sans avoir besoin que tout soit déjà parfait Bonus appréciés : - Une expérience sur des comptes grands groupes ou ETI en complément du SMB - Une expérience de vente sur un autre marché européen (Belgique, Espagne, Italie…) - Une connaissance du secteur EdTech ou des CFA / organismes de formation 🗺️ Poste basé à Paris, en télétravail partiel, dans une équipe majoritairement Full Remote. ⚙️ Process - Appel d’introduction avec l’équipe Talent (30min) - Entretien métier avec Elsa - Head of Revenue (1h) - Entretien avec Maxime - Founder & CEO (45min) - Étude de cas (1h) - Prises de références

jobs.title: Become a Tech Founder
jobs.description: Ready to roll up your sleeves and become an ambitious Tech Founder to build the next big thing? As a Tech founder at Hexa, you will have complete ownership & leadership on everything related to tech. But your impact will go far beyond tech. We expect you to take part in strategic decisions (GTM strategy, fundraising matters etc) in the same way as the Business Founder. Being part of Hexa means joining a strong & powerful tech community! You will constantly be surrounded by tech peers (i.e Tech Founders from current batch but also from our portfolio companies https://www.hexa.com/companies), a huge opportunity for you to learn from inspiring CTOs with whom you’ll share knowledge with. Last but not least, recruitment experts from Core Team will help you hire the best tech talents to build a strong tech team from the ground up - thanks to Hexa’s large network & powerful employer brand. In just 12 months, you will go faster than you ever been: starting with an idea we want to build together to a fully autonomous company. We'll be at your side, helping you build your team, develop your product, secure your first clients, and raise funding—all while financially backing you until your seed round. Are we the right fit for each other? This article https://www.hexa.com/blog/article/faq-what-do-we-look-for-in-founders breaks down what makes a great Hexa founder, and our approach https://www.hexa.com/journey shows how we help founders go from idea to scale. If you're building a company—whether now or in the future—let’s talk. The right conversation at the right time can change everything. Tell us about yourself [here] and let’s explore what we can build together 🚀

raw.descriptionHtml:
Join Hexa as an Intern. Build the next generation of startups!

Hexa started as eFounders in 2011 and has since become a leading startup studio, giving entrepreneurs the best chance to build outstanding companies. We have built over 40 companies, including Aircall, Spendesk, Front, Swan, and Yousign, with a combined valuation of $4.5bn.

At Hexa, interns don't fetch coffee. They shape companies. ✨

Whether you join our Core Team or one of our portfolio startups, you'll be embedded in real ventures, working alongside founders from day one.

If you're entrepreneurial by nature and want to learn more in 6 months than most people do in 3 years, keep reading.

 

Open internship opportunities

We are currently looking for interns across several teams:

- Scale Team - VC Analyst Support the Scale team in identifying, evaluating, and activating growth opportunities across Hexa's portfolio. You'll work closely with founders on go-to-market, partnerships, and expansion with a VC analyst mindset.

- Sprint Team - VC Analyst Join the Sprint team at the earliest stage of startup creation. You'll run market analyses, and work hands-on at the early phase of new ventures.

- Talent Team - Ops

At Hexa, finding the right people is a growth problem. You'll own the full sourcing stack and directly shape how we recruit founders and early employees across our portfolio.

- Studio - GTM Associate Work directly with the studio team on go-to-market strategy, business development, and growth for newly launched startups. Expect a mix of strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

- Portfolio Startups - Business Associate Join one of Hexa's freshly launched startups as its first business hire. You'll contribute across sales, ops, and strategy - and get to watch (and shape) a company being built from scratch.

 

What we look for in all our interns

- You don't need to have done it before. But you need to want to build. Across all these roles, we're looking for:

- An entrepreneurial mindset: you're full of ideas, you like to test things yourself, and you thrive in environments built on trust and autonomy

- Strong communication skills and intellectual curiosity: you're good at building relationships with people, you ask good questions and you're always curious about how things work!

- A genuine interest in startups, technology, and building things that matter.

 

Why intern at Hexa?

Work alongside repeat entrepreneurs and world-class operators Get real ownership and responsibility from week one Access to Hexa's network of founders, investors, and ecosystem leaders Based at La Cristallerie in Paris: with a gym, podcast studio, nap room, and vibrant startup community A caring, diverse, and impact-driven environment

 

Interested?

We'd love to hear from you. 😍 Send us an application telling us which role excites you most and why, and what you'd bring to the team. No lengthy cover letter needed: just be yourself.

 

Hexa is committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment irrespective of gender, origins, identity, background and sexual orientation

Nous entrons dans une phase clé de scaling et d'industrialisation de notre plateforme IA. Nous recherchons des builders qui souhaitent travailler à l'intersection des opérations d'assurance, du produit et de l'IA. POURQUOI CE RÔLE EXISTE Panora a atteint le product-market pull. Le produit est déjà déployé chez des cabinets de courtage, générant des gains opérationnels mesurables et résolvant des workflows douloureux dans un secteur longtemps sous-servi par le logiciel. Nous entrons maintenant dans un nouveau chapitre : scaler l'exécution commerciale, construire un moteur go-to-market reproductible, et devenir la plateforme IA de référence pour les courtiers en Europe. That's what we're building. Panora has live product, first paying customers, and a roadmap far bigger than our current team. The foundations are solid, built with Hexa's support, with strong technical and product groundwork already in place. Now we need someone to take ownership of that vision and turn it into a product brokers love. You'll be our first Product hire. You won't just manage a backlog, you'll shape how an entire industry modernizes.   3. Supporting our Portfolio: Act as a “GTM SWAT Team” for our live startups, helping their founders solve their most critical early-stage blocks (Sales, Ops, Product).

  • Ideation & Validation: Conduct deep-dive market analysis to decide which ideas we should launch next (Market sizing, competitor mapping, customer interviews).

  • Investment Committee: Help craft the narrative and build pitch decks to convince the Hexa partners to fund our new projects.

  • GTM Execution: Work alongside our Founders to set up their initial sales engines (Outbound campaigns, CRM setup, Lead scraping).

  • Operational SWAT: A Founder is drowning in admin or operations? You jump in, fix the process, automate it, and hand it back.
